sql: SELECT n.network_name, ROUND(AVG(e.significance), 1) AS avg_significance FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code = n.net_code WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.magnitude >= 3.0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY avg_significance DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT e.event_id, r.region_name, e.magnitude, i.felt_reports FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id = i.event_id JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports >= (SELECT AVG(felt_reports) FROM event_impacts WHERE felt_reports IS NOT NULL) + 2 ORDER BY i.felt_reports DESC, e.event_id ASC

SELECT m.description, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.tsunami_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), 3) AS tsunami_ratio FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code = m.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' GROUP BY m.description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY tsunami_ratio DESC, m.description ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(magnitude), 2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events WHERE region_id = 1 AND mag_type_code = 'ml'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE num_stations BETWEEN 18 AND 78
SELECT MAX(magnitude) AS max_magnitude FROM events WHERE depth_km < 10.0

SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE e.mag_type_code = 'ml' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT n.network_name, MAX(e.significance) AS max_significance FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code = n.net_code WHERE e.tsunami_flag = 0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY max_significance DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT m.description, ROUND(AVG(e.num_stations), 1) AS avg_num_stations FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code = m.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.num_stations IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.description ORDER BY avg_num_stations DESC, m.description ASC

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.num_stations >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_high_stations FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE e.num_stations IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY pct_high_stations DESC, r.region_name ASC
SELECT MAX(depth_km) AS max_depth_km FROM events WHERE mag_type_code = 'mb'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE review_status = 'automatic'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(magnitude), 2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events WHERE tsunami_flag = 1

SELECT n.network_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code = n.net_code WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.magnitude >= 3.0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, n.network_name ASC
